relations.myth: Gabriel promises the exiled Cid success in a dream
relations.note: Gabriel appears in a dream and promises Rodrigo success.

relations.myth: The Cid invokes Mary in prayer and warfare
relations.note: Rodrigo invokes Mary in prayers associated with his Christian victories.

relations.myth: The disguised Lazarus tests Rodrigo's hospitality
relations.note: Disguised as a leper, Lazarus tests Rodrigo when he shares food or lodging.

relations.myth: Lazarus blesses Rodrigo after the hospitality test
relations.note: After revealing himself, Lazarus rewards Rodrigo's compassion with a blessing.

relations.myth: Santiago aids the dead Cid's final victory
relations.note: Saint James assists Rodrigo's posthumous mounted sortie against Búcar's forces.
relations.source: Estoria de España and Cardeña complex

relations.myth: God grants fortune and victories to the Cid
relations.note: Rodrigo prays to God, who is credited with his fortune and victories.
